ops check-ins and document action items and decisions • Test new tools and processes in small pilots before full rollout • Assist with scheduling, resource planning, and deadline management • Document review_candidates.title: Senior Radio Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Summary We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Radio Software Engineer specializing in 4G/LTE to join our telecom engineering team. The ideal candidate will have 7+ years of experience in wireless telecommunications , with strong hands-on expertise in LTE RAN software development, integration, optimization, troubleshooting, and protocol implementation . The engineer will work closely with RAN architecture, system engineering, testing, and field teams to develop and enhance reliable LTE radio solutions and resolve complex network and software issues. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, integrate, and maintain 4G/LTE Radio Access Network software . Develop and optimize software components for eNodeB (eNB) platforms. Work on LTE protocol stack implementation and troubleshooting, including: PHY (Layer 1) MAC RLC PDCP RRC Analyze and troubleshoot complex radio software and protocol issues. Perform debugging using logs, traces, protocol analyzers, and network performance data. Support integration between radio software, baseband platforms, RF components, and LTE core network interfaces . Work with LTE interfaces and protocols such as S1, X2, S1AP, GTP, SCTP, and related 3GPP protocols . Participate in system integration, feature verification, interoperability testing, and performance testing. Optimize radio performance, capacity, stability, and reliability. Investigate field/network issues and perform root-cause analysis. Support software releases, upgrades, patches, and feature deployments. Collaborate with RF, hardware, core network, QA/testing, and field engineering teams. Review software architecture, design specifications, and technical documentation. Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance to the engineering team. Ensure solutions comply with relevant 3GPP LTE standards and specifications . Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or a related field. 10+ years of professional experience in wireless telecommunications and RAN software engineering. Strong hands-on experience with 4G/LTE RAN and eNodeB software . Deep understanding of the LTE protocol stack and 3GPP architecture . Strong knowledge of PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, and RRC layers . Strong knowledge of LTE call flows, signaling procedures, mobility, handovers, scheduling, and radio resource management. Strong programming experience in C/C++ , preferably in embedded or real-time telecom environments. Experience with Linux-based development environments . Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills using logs, traces, packet captures, and protocol analysis tools. Experience with Wireshark and/or similar telecom protocol analysis tools . Good understanding of IP networking and transport protocols, including TCP/IP, UDP, SCTP, and GTP . Experience with software version control and development tools such as Git . Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, integration, testing, and release processes. Preferred Skills Experience with LTE small cells, macro cells, or private LTE networks . Experience with RAN equipment vendors or telecom equipment manufacturers . Knowledge of Software Defined Radio (SDR) and radio/baseband architectures. Experience with O-RAN or virtualized/cloud-based RAN architectures is an advantage. Exposure to 5G NR and LTE-to-5G evolution is an advantage. Experience with performance optimization, KPI analysis, and field troubleshooting. Familiarity with automated testing, scripting, and tools such as Python, Bash, Jenkins, or CI/CD environments . Key Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to independently troubleshoot complex LTE/RAN issues. Strong understanding of end-to-end mobile network architecture. Excellent communication and technical documentation skills. Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed engineering teams. Ability to lead technical discussions and mentor less-experienced engineers. Experience Requirement Minimum 7 years of relevant telecom/RAN software engineering experience, with significant hands-on experience in 4G/LTE radio software development and integration.

With a focus on scalability, reliability, and advanced AI integration, Client Server is committed to pushing the boundaries of distributed systems and real-time communication technology. Your primary focus will be on designing and implementing highly scalable distributed systems, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and fault tolerance. You will work on key components such as low latency messaging, Pub/Sub services, state synchronization, and next-generation AI communication infrastructure. This position offers the opportunity to work in a modern, AI-first engineering environment, leveraging the latest tools and technologies to accelerate development while maintaining high standards of code quality and architectural integrity. The role provides flexibility with remote or hybrid working arrangements, with occasional visits to our North London office for team events and collaborations. Candidates should be comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for solving complex technical challenges. Familiarity with AI development tools and maintaining a focus on engineering quality is advantageous. Knowledge of Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, cloud infrastructure, or developer platforms will be considered a plus. A proactive attitude, excellent problem-solving skills, and a commitment to delivering production-grade software are key attributes for success in this role. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements and implement solutions that enhance system performance and reliability. Your role will involve optimizing low latency messaging, developing Pub/Sub services, and working on state synchronization mechanisms. You will also contribute to the architecture and technical decision-making process, ensuring the software remains robust, secure, and efficient. Additionally, you will leverage modern AI tools to streamline development workflows and improve system capabilities. Participating in code reviews, writing comprehensive documentation, and mentoring junior team members will be integral parts of your responsibilities. Benefits Client Server offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your professional and personal well-being. The package includes a salary up to £120,000, along with an EMI share option scheme that allows you to benefit from the company's growth. You will enjoy 28 days of annual leave, enhanced maternity and parental leave policies, and the flexibility to choose your preferred kit and home office setup. The company provides a personal learning and development budget of £1,000 annually, plus 5% of your working time dedicated to personal projects, fostering continuous growth. Health benefits include BUPA Health Insurance, dental coverage, and mental health support. Additional perks encompass pension schemes, life assurance, income protection, and a fully paid one-month sabbatical after five years of service. The organization also promotes a healthy lifestyle with gym subsidies, cycle-to-work schemes, and more, ensuring a supportive environment for all employees. Work extensively with PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse, and similar technologies to support high-volume trading data. Strong understanding of trading concepts, including orders, fills, order books, positions, and execution. Experience designing APIs for latency-sensitive, high-throughput applications and clients. Excellent debugging and performance optimization skills, including experience diagnosing slow queries, memory leaks, and production bottlenecks. Strong understanding of backend architecture, distributed systems, and integration patterns. Familiarity with EVM-based systems, DeFi, or on-chain data is advantageous. review_candidates.description: Role: Software Engineer Level III (Full-Stack) WHAT YOU'LL DO Technical Leadership & Architecture Lead end-to-end system design for complex, high-scale backend platforms — owning the full lifecycle from requirements through implementation and iteration Define architectural principles and engineering best practices that raise the quality bar across the team Make high-impact design decisions involving deliberate trade-offs between scalability, performance, cost, and long-term maintainability Design data models that are well-structured, efficient, and built to evolve alongside the product Full Stack Delivery Design, develop, and maintain full stack features across React/Angular frontends and Node.js backend microservices Build and evolve RESTful and event-driven APIs — both internal services and external-facing APIs consumed by our partners — ensuring they are well-tested, documented, and production-ready Work with MongoDB to design schemas, write efficient queries, and manage data at scale Develop and maintain event-driven workflows using AWS SNS and SQS to manage asynchronous system flows reliably Instrument services with monitoring and observability tooling — setting up metrics, alerts, dashboards, and distributed tracing to ensure system health Investigate and resolve complex bugs and production incidents end-to-end — from the UI down to the service layer Strategy & Growth Partner with product, design, and growth teams on growth initiatives — customer acquisition, activation, and conversion funnel improvements — translating experiment ideas into shippable, measurable features Contribute to experimentation and A/B testing efforts, using data and metrics to validate impact and inform the next iteration Align technical decisions with business strategy — weighing near-term growth opportunities against long-term platform health, and communicating those trade-offs clearly to stakeholders Conduct technical research and propose solutions to new and ambiguous engineering challenges Plan and manage your own work independently, breaking down large features into well-scoped tasks and driving them to delivery Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and contribute to engineering best practices Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers across the stack OUR TECH STACK Frontend: React (Jest), Angular 2+ (Jasmine & Karma), Next.js, Razzle, TypeScript Backend: Node.js microservices (Koa, NestJS) Database: MongoDB Messaging: AWS SNS & SQS (event-driven async flows) Cloud: AWS E2E Testing: Playwright Monitoring: AWS CloudWatch, Sentry AI Tooling: Claude Code (AI-assisted, agentic development) CI/CD: CircleCI WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 5+ years of professional full stack development experience, with a track record of leading system design on complex, high-scale platforms Proven ability to define architectural principles and drive engineering best practices across a team Experience making high-impact design decisions with clear reasoning around trade-offs — scalability vs. cost, performance vs. maintainability, speed vs. reliability Strong data modeling skills — designing schemas and structures that are clean, efficient, and built to scale Strong proficiency in Node.js — building and maintaining production microservices Solid experience with MongoDB — schema design, indexing, aggregation pipelines, and query optimization Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures, specifically AWS SNS and SQS or equivalent pub/sub and message queue systems Proficiency in React and/or Angular 2+ for building and maintaining modern frontend applications Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Sentry, or similar) — instrumenting services, creating dashboards, configuring alerts, and using distributed tracing to diagnose issues Experience writing tests across the stack — unit, integration, and E2E (Jest, Jasmine/Karma, Playwright or similar) General understanding of AWS services beyond messaging — S3, IAM, Lambda, EC2, or similar A business-minded approach to engineering — comfort connecting technical work to company goals, growth metrics, and customer outcomes Excellent research and investigation skills — able to navigate unfamiliar codebases and ambiguous technical challenges systematically Strong problem-resolution mindset — thorough, communicative, and effective under pressure Ability to plan and own complex features independently from design through to production Strong communication skills and comfort working in a remote, async-friendly environment BONUS POINTS Experience in InsurTech, FinTech, or other regulated industries Experience supporting growth engineering — experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, funnel analytics, or conversion optimization Experience with agentic coding and AI-assisted development workflows — using tools like Claude Code to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, or similar) Experience with CI/CD pipeline configuration — particularly CircleCI Direct involvement in building a new application from the ground up or leading a large-scale migration (e.g., a framework or database migration) Familiarity with homegrown or complex internal component libraries on the frontend Contributions to open source projects

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer - Foodics ERP
review_candidates.description: Who Are We ❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell💡 Foodics powers thousands of restaurants across the region — point of sale, payments, inventory, and the operational backbone underneath. We're now building our own accounting platform: the layer that takes everything a merchant already does in Foodics and turns it into a clean, closed set of books, without the merchant doing the work twice. This is a new product being built from zero by a small squad. You'll be one of the first engineers on it. The scope is real — a ledger, core accounting modules, ZATCA compliance, and deep integration into inventory, payments and the POS. The timeline is aggressive and the ambiguity is high, which is the point. What Will You Do❓ Design and build the core accounting product — general ledger, chart of accounts, journals, AP/AR, reconciliation, financial reporting — on our stack Own the integration surface: inventory, payments, POS transaction flows, and regulatory e-invoicing Work full stack. There is no backend-only or frontend-only seat on a team this size Turn accounting requirements into system design, in close partnership with a product manager and a domain accountant Use AI tooling as a core part of how you build — evaluating reference systems, generating and reviewing code, accelerating everything that can be accelerated Make architectural calls early and defend them. Financial data doesn't forgive a weak foundation Ship in weeks, not quarters, and put it in front of real merchants to find out what's wrong with it Required What Are We Looking For❓ 5+ years building production software, with meaningful time on accounting, ERP, or financial systems — you understand double-entry, period close, and why a ledger is not just another table Strong full-stack engineering. Comfortable owning a feature from schema to screen AI-native way of working. You use agents and LLM tooling daily, you have judgment about where their output can be trusted and where it can't, and you're measurably faster because of it Track record of shipping fast in an early-stage or greenfield environment — small team, short cycles Care for correctness in systems where being wrong is expensive Able to work substantially within GMT+3 hours Strong plus Product instinct — you don't stop at implementation, you shape what gets built alongside your Product partner Built or operated a ledger, double-entry engine, or transaction-processing system at scale Fintech, banking, payments or financial services background Familiarity with ERP platforms (ERPNext, Odoo, NetSuite, SAP) — as a builder, an integrator, or a serious user Experience with ZATCA e-invoicing or comparable regional tax and regulatory integrations Shipped AI-powered features, not just used AI to write code Arabic Speaker What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company

review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Hyperliquid ecosystem
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer - Hyperliquid ecosystem based in Ireland. Join a high-growth team building infrastructure at the forefront of decentralized financial markets. You will own critical backend systems powering real-time trading, data pipelines, APIs, and high-volume databases. Your work will directly support products used by hundreds of thousands of traders and designed to scale to millions of users. You’ll solve challenging problems around latency, reliability, data consistency, and performance in a fast-moving environment. The role offers significant ownership, with the opportunity to shape architecture and take products from 0 to 1. You’ll collaborate closely with frontend and mobile engineers in a team that values technical excellence and product craftsmanship. This is a fully remote position open across Europe or the USA, with required overlap with EST working hours. Accountabilities Own key architecture and technical decisions across backend systems, ensuring they remain scalable, reliable, and performant. Build and operate real-time data pipelines handling order book updates, trades, and market events. Design, develop, and maintain API infrastructure, including GraphQL and WebSockets, for web and mobile clients. Work extensively with PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse, and similar technologies to support high-volume trading data. Optimize queries, caching strategies, schemas, and data access patterns as usage and data volumes grow. Instrument services with appropriate metrics, monitoring, and alerting, and participate in on-call rotations. Investigate and resolve latency, memory, performance, and reliability issues under demanding production workloads. Partner with frontend and mobile engineers to deliver analytical and real-time data through robust APIs. Contribute to a fast-paced 0-to-1 development environment where engineers have meaningful ownership over what they build. Requirements 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience, ideally with strong production experience in TypeScript. Proven experience designing and operating real-time systems using WebSockets, event streaming, pub/sub, or similar technologies. Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL and Redis; experience with ClickHouse or another columnar database is highly valued. Demonstrated experience operating highly available services at significant scale. Strong understanding of trading concepts, including orders, fills, order books, positions, and execution. Experience designing APIs for latency-sensitive, high-throughput applications and clients. Excellent debugging and performance optimization skills, including experience diagnosing slow queries, memory leaks, and production bottlenecks. Strong understanding of backend architecture, distributed systems, and integration patterns. Familiarity with EVM-based systems, DeFi, or on-chain data is advantageous. Experience with Kafka or comparable streaming technologies is a plus. Background in trading platforms, fintech, low-latency applications, or other performance-critical environments is a plus. Strong ownership, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to thrive in an ambiguous and rapidly evolving environment. Benefits Salary: $150,000–$200,000 USD per year for a full-time permanent position, plus equity and benefits. Remote-first: Work remotely from Europe or the USA. Remote setup stipend: Budget for a laptop, peripherals, and other equipment needed to create your ideal workspace. Global collaboration: Multiple in-person team offsites and coworking opportunities around the world. Flexible vacation: Flexible time-off policy with genuine encouragement to disconnect and recharge. Learning & development: Dedicated budget to support continuous learning and professional growth. Permanent employment: Full-time, permanent contract with a remote working model. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.title: Junior/ Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Go/Java)
review_candidates.description: About LINE MAN Wongnai LINE MAN Wongnai is Thailand’s Leading On-Demand Delivery and Lifestyle e-Commerce platform services. We build technology to help Thai people live better, to empower all local businesses by creating an end-to-end food ecosystem through our channel LINE MAN and Wongnai. Connected consumers, riders, and local businesses and improved the daily life of all parties with restaurants nationwide. And because we are local, we provide the deepest variety and services that are tailor-made for Thai people. We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in order to perform quality control and resolving structural design. Working in a fast-paced environment, you will bring your expertise and skills to tackle the challenges that impact millions of people on our journey to become the No.1 food platform in Thailand. We are currently opening for our Food Delivery and Financial Products teams. What you’ll Do: Design and develop backend systems for LINE MAN Wongnai which covers a wide range of businesses including Food delivery, Ride Hailing, Messenger, Supermarket, Restaurant, Payment and Financial Products Design and develop the back-office that enables high performance and scalability. The technologies we use include Golang, Java, Python, Node.js, gRPC, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Git, CI/CD, Grafana, ELK, Airflow, AWS, Data pipeline and more You will start your end-to-end software development experience from design, writing, source code, testing, deploying, production, bug fixing, and keeping the system up and running to provide the best user experience Lead designs of major software components, systems, features and help building a team and cultivate innovation by driving cross-collaboration and execution of projects across multiple teams Work in a cross-functional team consisting of developers, QA engineers, UX/UI designers, and a product manager who help each other develop the system to meet the needs of customers as much as possible and make a real impact that will benefit the team and users of LINE MAN Wongnai What you’ll Need: Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field of specialization preferred A minimum of 5 years experience in software engineer or any field-related Ability to develop software in any of the following: Golang, Java Experience with the APIs and microservice architectures Experience with test-driven development Experience in DevOps Practices and CI/CD Pipelines Experience in using Docker to create Docker Images and Deploy Docker Containers Basic knowledge of frontend development technologies such as JavaScript, HTML, and CSS Proficiency in troubleshooting software issues and debugging a large codebase Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities Able to communicate in both spoken and written English and Thai.
